verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Deel organizes consulate appointments and gives personalized eligibility advice. It also lists destination countries it covers. None of this is published origin-country guidance: there are no consulate processing details, country backlog information, or dedicated pages for founders from a specific nationality. Those adjacent services and the destination coverage earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a founder abroad, the provider publishes origin-country-specific guidance — consulate processing, country backlogs, or dedicated pages for founders from my country
